mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 220, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 90.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) triggers accommodative monetary policy, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 is rising, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.
